youtube.title: Why CDs Flash Rainbows When You Tilt Them 🌈 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A compact disc has no pigment at all: it is a clear plastic disc with a thin aluminum layer. Its data is stored in one spiral track more than three miles long, with neighboring rows only 1.6 micrometers apart. Rows that fine act as a diffraction grating, bending each color of white light in a different direction, so the rainbow changes as you tilt the disc.
